description:
Taeyang doesn’t believe in love—not after the wounds left by his past relationships. Ha Hyeon, a sultry and enigmatic adult webtoon artist, has spent her life dodging judgment and misconceptions about her work. When fate throws them together in an open chatroom meet-up, the chemistry is undeniable, and by the end of the night, they find themselves tangled in heated passion. But secrets don’t stay hidden for long. Ha Hyeon’s irresistible allure catches the attention of the entire chatroom, and soon, whispers spread. Not all curiosity is innocent—some have dangerous intentions. As intrigue and obsession begin to swirl, Taeyang realizes their encounter was anything but a one-time affair.

(Source: Lezhin US)
